hard_case: the spot-check's --workspace miss ran on code behind the non-default profiling-traced feature, which was not compiled; truth here comes from a build with the feature on.

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent with --features profiling-traced: ATUIN_OTEL=http://host:4318 exports to http://host:4318/ instead of .../v1/traces, and a URL already ending in /v1/traces gets /v1/traces/v1/traces. Equivalent (dead code) in the spot-check's --workspace build: enabled.rs is behind #[cfg(feature = "profiling-traced")], a non-default feature no workspace member enables, so the file is not compiled there.
not equivalent with --features profiling-traced: a URL already ending in /v1/traces gets the suffix twice.

reasoning: The spot-check's missed outcome is uninformative: under --workspace default features enabled.rs is not compiled, so the mutant is dead code there. With --features profiling-traced the file compiles, but no test sets ATUIN_OTEL or calls OtelCtx::try_enable (LogCtx::try_enable is only called from command dispatch), so both non-equivalent mutants pass and the line is not discriminated. Diff-mode ripr reports infection_unknown (limited), with two daemon.rs tests linked only by a shared name token and observe/discriminate = no. An acceptable abstention; a gap would be ideal.
